documents.title: ParadeDB & pgvector Hybrid Retrieval Spec
documents.content:
# ParadeDB & pgvector Hybrid Retrieval Spec

## 1. Sparse BM25 Engine
TerraceMem uses ParadeDB `pg_search` powered by Rust Tantivy. For Chinese and English mixed corpora, the BM25 index configures the `jieba` tokenizer on `lexical_text` and pushes `tenant_id` and `namespace` down via Fast Fields (`===`).

## 2. Iterative Vector Scan
Dense embeddings use `pgvector 0.8` `halfvec(1024)` with HNSW (`m = 16`, `ef_construction = 128`). During filtered retrieval, TerraceMem runs `SET LOCAL hnsw.iterative_scan = 'relaxed_order'` inside the transaction to prevent post-filtering starvation.

## 3. Native Fallback
When `TERRACEMEM_LEXICAL_BACKEND=native` is enabled on standard PostgreSQL, `doc_chunks.search_tokens` is populated using `jieba.cut_for_search` and queried via `plainto_tsquery('simple', ...)`.

documents.title: Gateway Error Reference v2
documents.content:
# Gateway Error Reference

## ERR_GATEWAY_42
Current retry interval for `ERR_GATEWAY_42` is 5 seconds with exponential jitter (`ERR_GATEWAY_42_JITTER`).

## ERR_AUTH_401
Occurs when EdDSA JWT clock skew exceeds 30 seconds.

## ERR_QUOTA_429
Rate limiter burst ceiling is 120 requests per minute per `tenant_id`.

| Error Code | HTTP Status | Mitigation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ERR_GATEWAY_42` | 502 | Retry after 5s with jitter |
| `ERR_AUTH_401` | 401 | Refresh EdDSA token |
| `ERR_QUOTA_429` | 429 | Honor `Retry-After` header |

documents.title: Bi-temporal Three-Tier Memory Design
documents.content:
# Bi-temporal Three-Tier Memory Design

## 1. L1 Working Memory
L1 working memory maintains `pinned_constraints` in `sessions` so critical hard rules are never evicted during `session_compactions` rolling compression.

## 2. L2 Episodic Memory
`episodic_memories` archives timestamped conversation windows, `key_decisions`, and `entities_mentioned` asynchronously via `PostgresOutboxWorker`.

## 3. L3 Semantic Bi-temporal Axes
L3 separates valid time (`valid_from`, `valid_to`) from transaction time (`recorded_at`, `invalidated_at`, `superseded_by`). Four deterministic guardrails block hypothetical modalities, confidence below `0.75`, historical backfills (`event_time < valid_from`), and silent overwrites of `is_pinned=true` facts.

documents.title: Agentic RAG FSM & Execution Budgets
documents.content:
# Agentic RAG FSM & Execution Budgets

## 1. ExecutionBudget Ceilings
Default budgets enforce `max_retrieval_retries = 2`, `max_state_transitions = 10`, `max_llm_calls = 5`, and `request_timeout_seconds = 30.0`, while `seen_query_fingerprints` blocks duplicate rewrite loops.

## 2. Two-Level CRAG Gate
Evidence scoring below `0.15` triggers rewrite or rejection; scores at or above `0.72` bypass the extra LLM judge call (`SUFFICIENT`).

## 3. CitationVerifier
`CitationVerifier` validates every cited `chunk_id` against the retrieved evidence whitelist and triggers `STRICT_ABSTAIN` if any ID is fabricated.

documents.title: Zero-Redis PG Outbox & MCP Transport
documents.content:
# Zero-Redis PG Outbox & MCP Transport

## 1. SKIP LOCKED Queue
`PostgresOutboxWorker` drains `async_jobs` using `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED` and exponential backoff (`5s * 2^attempts`), moving jobs to `dead` after `max_attempts = 3`. `LISTEN/NOTIFY` wakes idle workers immediately.

## 2. MCP SDK v2 Tools
TerraceMem mounts Streamable HTTP MCP at `/mcp` and exposes six tools: `kb_browse_outline`, `kb_search`, `kb_ask`, `memory_recall`, `memory_commit`, and `memory_timeline`.

documents.title: Gateway & AuthCore Topology
documents.content:
# Gateway & AuthCore Topology

## 1. Edge Routing
`ServiceGateway` forwards external requests to `AuthCore` over mTLS.

## 2. Token Validation
`AuthCore` validates incoming sessions using `EdDSAJWT` with a 15-minute access token lifetime.

documents.title: TerraceMem 中文部署与双时态指南
documents.content:
# TerraceMem 中文部署与双时态指南

## 1. 统一数据库底座
TerraceMem 使用单一 PostgreSQL 统一底座承载文档树、向量检索和双时态记忆，彻底移除 Redis 与外部图数据库。

## 2. 写时精炼增强
开启 `ENABLE_WRITE_TIME_ENRICHMENT=true` 时，入库管线会自动提炼章节摘要和同义关键词写入 `enriched_keywords`，并合并到生成列 `lexical_text` 中增强 BM25 字面召回。
